meta.name: Report Export Sample
meta.description: Pick a period to see overview numbers, a period comparison table, source and device charts, an insight and improvement ideas; 'Save report' exports only the report as HTML

msg.welcome: Choose a period. Use 'Compare' in the calendar to choose how the comparison period is decided (preceding period, last year, etc.). It starts with 'Preceding period'.
msg.title: ## Site report
msg.head: Current period = {$period_start} - {$period_end} ({$period_days} days) / Comparison period = {$period_compare_start} - {$period_compare_end} ({$period_compare_days} days)
msg.save_hint: Press 'Save report' above the conversation to save these results as a report-only HTML file (no character or chat bubbles). Open it in a browser and print it to make a PDF.
msg.no_prev: The comparison period has no data, so the report could not be made. Please choose another period.
msg.error: Could not load the data. Please try again.

chart.sources: Sessions by source domain (top 8, excluding direct visits)

insight.title: Insight
insight.text: Compared with the comparison period, sessions changed by **{$diff_sessions|signed:0}** ({$rate_sessions|signed:1}%) and the bounce rate by **{$diff_bounce|signed:1} points**. See the charts above for sources and devices.

html.ideas:
• For sources whose sessions grew, review the paths from their landing pages so visitors move on to the next page more easily.
  • When the bounce rate rises, check that the first screen of each landing page tells visitors right away what the page is about.
  • When the smartphone share is high, fix smartphone page speed and tap targets first.
